description: Conversion of Use Class C3 (single dwelling house) to Use Class C3b (up to five people living together as a single household and receiving care) including single storey rear extension, rear dormer and front roof lights.
decision_conditions: The proposed rear extension, by reason of measuring more than half the width of the original property, would  not constitute Permitted Development under Article 3 and Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended).

Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate, on the balance of probability, that the proposed use would fall within Class C3(b) of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended. Although the submission confirms a maximum of five residents, non-resident staff and shift-based care, it does not provide sufficient details of staffing levels, rota arrangements, the care provided or how the residents would function as a single household. The proposed Class C3(b) use cannot therefore be certified as lawful under section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
